entities.name: Kari Aalvik Grimsbø
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kari Aalvik Grimsbø is a former Norwegian handball player who last played for Győri ETO KC and the Norwegian national team. She is both an Olympic, European and World Champion. Since her retirement she is the goalkeeping coach at Byåsen HE.
